verdict.rationale: Gazebo exposes programmatic interfaces (gz-transport socket-based message passing, C++ libraries like gz-math/sdformat, and extensive CLI tools) that let external programs drive simulations, and these are documented on the official site. However, probes confirm there is no REST/OpenAPI-style public API and no AI-consumable docs endpoint (llms.txt 404, openapi.json 404), so it's not a modern AI-native API surface. Missing for 10: a REST/HTTP or OpenAPI-documented API, machine-readable API spec, and explicit AI-agent-oriented documentation (llms.txt or similar).
